what: per-class IoU on the 15-class DALES 2 taxonomy as published, quoted for comparison; not computed here
source: Bendjilali, M., Peyran, C., Velumani, K., Mauri, A., Luminari, N., Alliez, P. DALES 2: A Renovated Aerial LiDAR Benchmark for 3D Scene Understanding. CVPR Workshops (USM3D), 2026. Table 5, page 8
protocol_as_stated: the original DALES split, 29 training tiles and 11 test tiles; models trained from scratch with each official implementation and hyperparameters adapted to DALES 2; mIoU over all 15 classes
protocol_not_stated: the input features, any subsampling before evaluation, and whether test-time voting is used
differences_from_this_repository: this repository scores voxel-thinned points with the softmax averaged over voted passes, and its published model reads geometry only
